  • • soup vegetables (carrot, parsley, onion, celery)
  • • salt and pepper
  • • 1 cup sliced fresh mushrooms
  • • 2 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 small cauliflower
  • • juice of 1-2 lemons
  • • 2 egg yolks
  • • 2 tablespoons butter and 3 tablespoons flour for the roux.

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Cook chicken and soup vegetables in lightly salted boiling water. When cool enough to handle, dice the chicken, discard soup vegetables, reserve the broth. While the chicken cooks, heat 2 tablespoons butter in a skillet and sauté the mushrooms over medium heat (about 4 minutes) – must not be too soft. Remove from heat and reserve. Cook cauliflower in lightly salted boiling water – do not overcook, must be tender, not mushy. Drain and separate in rosettes. Reserve. In a large skillet melt the remaining 2 tablespoons butter, add 3 tablespoons flour and stir over low/medium heat until golden brown. Add 1-1/2 cups of the reserved chicken broth and simmer, uncovered, until the mixture thickens, 5-10 minutes. Add juice of 1 lemon, diced chicken, simmer 2 minutes. Blend in egg yolks, mushrooms and cauliflower rosettes. Season to taste with salt, pepper, more lemon juice. If the ragoût is too thick, add a little more chicken broth. Serve as is with boiled potatoes, lettuce.

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 12 young venison cutlets, or medallions, 3 oz. ea.
  • • 12 juniper berries, crushed
  • • 4 tablespoons cognac
  • • salt and pepper
  • • 1·1/2 cups sour cream
  • • 1/2 cup chicken broth
  • • 3/4 cup olive oil
  • • 4 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 small onion, finely chopped
  • • 1 lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced lengthwise
  • • snipped parsley

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Trim excess fat from the cutlets, pound them lightly, rub with juniper berries, sprinkle with salt and pepper, drizzle with cognac and olive oil. Cover, marinate at least 1 hour.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Meanwhile melt butter in a large skillet, sauté onion and mushrooms. Season with salt and pepper. Reserve.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Drain and wipe the cutlets, reserve marinade. Heat remaining oil in a heavy frying pan, fry venison over high heat, about 3 minutes each side. Remove cutlets, keep them warm. Deglaze pan with marinade. Add chicken broth and sour cream, simmer 5 minutes. Taste for salt and pepper.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Coat the cutlets, or medallions, with the sauce. Garnish with mushrooms, snipped parsley, poached halves of apples, serve with noodles, rice.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 20 minutes, plus marinating

children.html: Roast pheasant - Bažant pečený

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 pheasant
  • • 2 slices bacon cut in short strips
  • • 6 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 medium onion, finely chopped
  • • 3·4 tablespoons flour
  • • 1·1/2 cups chicken broth
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Rinse and wipe the pheasant inside and out. Lard the breast and thighs with bacon strips. Brown the pheasant evenly all around in a frying pan in half of the butter and onion. Preheat oven to 350F. Transfer pheasant, breast down, into an ovenproof deep dish together with the butter and onion from the frying pan. Add salt and pepper. Roast 30·40 minutes, until the top gets reddish. Baste often with the remaining butter and chicken broth. Turn the bird breast side up, continue roasting in the same manner, 40-45 minutes.

children.html: Pheasant in cream sauce - Bažant na smetanë

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 pheasant
  • • 6 tablespoons butter
  • • 2 slices bacon cut in short strips
  • • 1 medium onion, finely chopped
  • • 1 cup chicken broth
  • • 1-1/2 cups heavy cream
  • • 2 tablespoons grated horseradish
  • • 1 tablespoon cognac
  • • juice of 1 lemon
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Rinse and wipe the pheasant inside and out. Lard the breast and thighs with bacon strips. Roast pheasant as indicated in "Roast pheasant". In a saucepan blend pan juices, cream and horseradish. Cook for 5 minutes over medium heat. Add cognac and lemon juice. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Strain.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Pour some gravy over the pheasant cut in 4 portions. Serve remaining gravy separately. Serve with rice, vegetables.

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 6 quails
  • • 3 slices bacon
  • • 6 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 cup chicken broth, or water
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Rinse quails, pat dry. Sprinkle with salt and pepper inside and outside. Place 1/2 slice bacon inside each. Heat butter in a flameproof casserole, add quails. Roast 40-50 minutes at 350F. Baste often with pan drippings, chicken broth or water. Serve dish straight from the oven with quails cut in halves.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html:
Arrange carp steaks in a single layer in a well oiled baking pan.
Season with caraway seeds, salt and pepper. Bake at 350F 25-30
minutes, or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.
In a saucepan heat butter until lightly browned. Pour over fish.
Garnish with lemon wedges.
Serve with potatoes, vegetables, salad.

children.html: Fried carp - Kapr smažený

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html:
Soak fish 30 minutes in lightly salted milk. Dredge each piece in flour,
dip in beaten eggs, coat with bread crumbs. Fry in hot oil until golden,
about 4 minutes each side. Drain on paper towel.
Serve on lettuce lined platter, garnish with lemon wedges and parsley
sprigs.
Serve with potato salad, green salad, vegetables.

children.html: Carp with paprika sauce - Kapr na paprice

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 6 carp steaks, 3-4 lbs.
  • • 1-1/2 cups water or fish broth
  • • 6 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 medium onion, finely chopped
  • • parsley, finely chopped
  • • 2 tablespoons paprika
  • • salt
  • • 3 tablespoons butter and 4 tablespoons flour for the roux

Optional: 1/2 cup heavy cream

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Melt butter in a large saucepot, add onion and cook until translucent. Add parsley and paprika, simmer 3 minutes. Add the fish and some of the fish broth or water.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Cover and simmer 15-20 minutes.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Using a slotted spatula, lift the carp portions onto a heated platter. For sauce, melt butter in a skillet and stir in flour. Cook and stir until golden.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Add cooking liquid from the carp and some of the fish broth if needed. Cook until sauce thickens. Optional: for a creamier sauce blend in heavy cream. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Strain over fish. Serve with mashed potatoes, rice, tomato salad.

children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 45 minutes

children.html: Salmon trout with dill sauce - Pstruh s koprovou omáčkou

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 6 trouts, 4 lbs., cleaned, with heads and tails left on
  • • 1/2 bottle white wine
  • • 1.1/2 quarts water
  • • 1 medium onion, quartered
  • • juice of one lemon
  • • 10 black peppercorns
  • • 2 bay leaves
  • • 6 tablespoons butter
  • • parsley, finely chopped
  • • salt

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
children.html: Sauce:

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 3 tablespoons butter and 4 tablespoons flour
  • • 2 tablespoons finely chopped dill
  • • 1 small onion, finely chopped
  • • parsley, finely chopped
  • • 2 cups fish broth
  • • 1 tablespoon vinegar
  • • 1 teaspoon sugar
  • • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • • salt

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html:
Heat the wine, water, onion, lemon juice, bay leaves and peppercorns. Simmer 10 minutes. Add the trouts and simmer gently for 15 minutes, without boiling.

Drain fish, arrange on a heated serving platter, keep it warm. Strain the broth from the fish, reserve 2 cups for dill sauce. Meanwhile, prepare the sauce. Melt butter in a saucepan, blend in flour, stir and cook until golden. Add onion, parsley, fish broth, vinegar, sugar, salt. Cook, uncovered, until sauce thickens. Strain. Blend in the cream and chopped dill. Heat through, do not boil. Pour hot butter over trouts, garnish with parsley. Hand sauce separately.
